additional_info.subject: RE: ID0417628-DC/Si-D/AT-[ MP / S2 170003381] charging error CRM:02679000067
additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes Dissauer,
I have checked the charging session I could see that the meterStart and meterStop values for the session were the same. To resolve this issue a hotfix was introduced for the FW 6.1.3 and I can see that it is already installed on the charger.
This session happened on 2nd of April and the FW hotfix was installed after 2nd April. Hence now, it should be resolved. I request you to observe the charger for some more days and if the issue is seen resolved then please close the ticket.

HI,
Where did you get the information that the hotfix was only installed on April 2nd?
I spoke with Benjamin, who applied the hotfix.
The hotfix was already applied on March 27, 2025, and therefore does not solve the problem. I urgently request a solution.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0417628-DC/Si-D/AT-[ MP / S2 170003381] charging error CRM:02679000067
additional_info.body:
Dear Johannes Dissauer,
I extremely apologize for the incorrect information regarding the date of hotfix applied. Indeed, as you pointed out, the hotfix was applied on 27th March and not after 2nd April.
The issue has occurred after the Hotfix was applied; hence I will work with the ES team for a resolution for this and update you the same.
The issue regarding the meterStart = meterStop is known to ES, hence I will push for troublshooting steps.
Once again, I apologize for the wrong communication.
Thank you.
With best regards,
